title: Sunday · her crab
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The best flyer on the wall, close, for a whole tier: Gully's daughter's careful crab from a photo, nine years old, joints right, shaded. The strip gives a child's drawing the Sunday.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the twenty-second flyer, filling the tier: a careful pencil crab with correct joints and shading, hand lettering above it, the pin's shadow.

image.prompt: a flyer filling the frame with a careful pencil drawing of a crab with correct joints and shading beneath hand lettering, a pushpin's shadow, no words legible
image.notes: dw_2019-02-08's flyer. Better than the strip's crabs; draw it so.

panels.name: Crab

panels.composition: Tier 2: the whole wall from a step back: twenty-two, and hers the one the eye goes to.

image.prompt: a shingle wall with twenty-two crab flyers where the newest is plainly the best drawn, no words legible

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 3: through the door, the end stool, empty, and the corkboard. The strip isn't at the counter this morning. Held.

image.prompt: a shack's open door showing an empty end stool and a crowded corkboard inside, no words

panels.name: Stool

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk
